*📢 WETECH VIBE CODING HACKATHON 2026* 

Applications are now open for the Wetech Vibe Coding Hackathon 2026, a one-day AI-powered hackathon bringing together student builders to create practical solutions, collaborate, and compete for exciting prizes.

👥 Eligibility: 
• Students interested in AI and software development
• Teams of 5 members

📍 Location: • AI UniPod, University of Lagos

🏆 Prize Pool: • ₦1,000,000

📅 Event Date: • September 19, 2026

⏳ Application Deadline: • June 19, 2026

👉 Apply here: https://event.wetech.africa/hack
